2609.27982.title: Riemannian Structure and Optimization for a Class of Low-Parametric Orthogonal Matrices
2609.27982.paper_summary: In this paper, we are concerned with matrices formed by block-diagonal factors interleaved with fixed permutations -- a flexible family of structured matrices. This class has recently drawn interest in deep learning architectures for its balanced expressivity-efficiency trade-off, yet efficient computational strategies for working with it remain to be found. We approach this problem through Riemannian geometry and examine under what conditions this class admits a smooth manifold structure. For the practically important case of orthogonal two-factor matrices, we derive the essential Riemannian tools and propose efficient algorithms for their implementation. The algorithms leverage automatic differentiation, support parameter sharing within each factor, and avoid explicit dense matrix construction. We test them within the Riemannian optimization framework on the best matrix approximation problem and for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models. Beyond the two-factor setting, we study the geometric and matrix-theoretic properties of factorizations with a larger number of block-diagonal factors.
2609.27982.paper_summary_zh: 在本文中，我們關注由區塊對角因素交錯固定置換所形成的矩陣——這是一個靈活的結構化矩陣家族。這一類別最近在深度學習架構中引起了興趣，因為它在表達能力和效率之間取得了平衡的權衡，但針對其的高效計算策略仍有待發現。我們通過黎曼幾何來處理這個問題，並檢查在什麼條件下這一類別允許光滑流形結構。對於實際重要的正交雙因素矩陣情況，我們推導出必要的黎曼工具並提出高效的實現算法。這些算法利用自動微分，支持每個因素內部的參數共享，並避免顯式的稠密矩陣構建。我們在黎曼優化框架內測試它們，針對最佳矩陣近似問題以及大語言模型的參數高效微調。超越雙因素設置，我們研究具有更多區塊對角因素的分解的幾何和矩陣理論特性。
2609.27982.author: Ali Aliev et.al.
